collection.description: An elder shows young villagers how to fold a leaf into a boat.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1), an elder, shows young villagers how to fold a leaf into a boat. The smallest boat travels farthest, provoking delighted disbelief.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), an elder, shows young villagers how to fold a leaf into a boat. Nobody wants the game to end, even when supper is called.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1), an elder, shows young villagers how to fold a leaf into a boat. One boat spins in circles, to the delight of its maker.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (Name1), an elder, shows young villagers how to fold a leaf into a boat. (Name1) had expected to win and is surprised not to mind losing.
